acceptance_rule: plain words plus a next step, no traceback, image and processes clean
verdict_reason: Good: the HTTP 500 dummy was not taken for ComfyUI (34 health probes, all rejected), the supervisor and ComfyUI were gone when the error appeared (supervisor: 'backend exited with code 1'), nothing alive 10 s after GIMP exit, image untouched. Bad: no port check before launching, so the user waits about 29 s while ComfyUI loads only to fail binding; the message is a raw ComfyUI log dump with ANSI color codes, claims 'within 240 s', and the only next step in it is ComfyUI's own '--port' advice instead of the plug-in's URL setting.
notes: ComfyUI was started with extra_server_args '--cpu --verbose INFO' so it never touched the GPU (see rob-extra-server-args-dash for why a single '--cpu' could not be used).
